Chats open in the real thread screen, in talk-only mode

Every screen below is Deck's real interface, captured from the running app with sample data (no real chats). The desktop screens are edited copies of today's thread screen; the phone screens are captured from the phone app, with proposed matching Move controls and a moved, read-only state added here. Use the buttons above each frame. "Work thread (today)" is the same conversation in a normal Work thread, for comparison. Yellow numbers match the list under the frames.

Phone

Where "Move to a Work thread" goes

  1. 2Desktop: a button in the thread's title bar, left of the window buttons. Always visible, so nobody has to hunt for it.
  2. 5Desktop: also in the ⋯ menu, in the slot where a Work thread has "Project ›".
  3. Phone: in the ⋯ sheet (already built), and as a link in each bot's Access section.
  4. 6Both: a bot's Access setting reads "talk only" in a chat. You pick access per bot in the Move dialog.

What stays exactly as in a thread

  • Message rows: time, copy, quote, pin, read aloud, retry, revert, actions menu
  • Bot chips with model, reasoning, Speed, context and plan meters 3
  • Bot settings: Model, Reasoning, Speed, Resets, Voice
  • Composer, @mentions, TL;DR, /compact, /clear, /export
  • ⋯ menu: Rename, Pin, Mark as unread, Share as PDF, Copy, Export, Open in new window, Archive, Delete
  • Add bot, kick bot, fold bots

Questions for you

  1. Fork (⋯ menu and /fork): keep it in chats? It would make a new chat with the same messages. Shown kept on desktop for now.
  2. Voice calls in chats: the phone hides the mic today. Keep it hidden on both, or allow calls in chats?
  3. Photos: chats can't take files today. A photo to talk about ("what is this plant?") is the one file type that fits a chat. Allow photos only, or keep it out?

Proposed Move controls now match on both: Read-only, Ask, Edit, Full. Phone's After the move tab shows the retained, read-only chat and its Work thread link.
